scope: Core refactor: pure decoding, request planning, tool identities, versioned history/replay, protocol output encoders
regressions: root and namespaced tools retain distinct identities
function and custom tools with the same public name remain distinct
routed replay is restored against the actual upstream model
stored histories drop signatures when the actual model changes
input system/developer messages persist independently of top-level instructions
legacy responses retain visible history; new records include model provenance
v1 and v2 replay carriers reject tampering and cross-model reuse
storage failures are not masked as missing cache entries
planning does not mutate the decoded request
acceptance failures return a nonzero exit status

notes: Both original full-run reports are retained in ignored local artifacts; latest_per_case replaces only the four explicitly rerun thinking cases.
The first thinking assertion incorrectly required a visible block. Native probes confirmed text signatures with no visible thought parts and successful signature restoration.
A later arithmetic assertion rejected correct LaTeX grouping such as 34{,}013. The comparison and its unit tests were corrected before the targeted recheck.
Image generation and editing passed in the first full run; the second full run encountered exhausted image quota.

precommit_review.finding: Conversation validation ran during pure decoding, before previous_response_id history was available, rejecting instruction-only and compaction-trigger continuations.
precommit_review.resolution: Validate scalar intent fields during decoding; require nonempty conversation after history merge and replay, before adding synthetic continuation or compaction prompts.
regressions: stored continuation containing only developer instructions
input token counting with stored history and developer instructions
stored continuation containing only a compaction trigger
compaction endpoint with stored history and developer instructions
empty or fully dropped histories remain invalid for generation, counting and compaction
allowed_tools auto preserves exactly the requested callable subset
precommit_review.live_validation_note: No additional real-account run for the validation-order fix; live and client results above describe the preceding refactor build.
